needs_review.issue: First-name-only roster (the brief's named trap) — Harvard Catholic Center
needs_review.finding: The Harvard Catholic Center states it partners with FOCUS and has 'a team of four missionaries'. No names of any of the four appeared in any retrievable snippet of harvardcatholic.org/staff or /meet-our-staff.
needs_review.recommendation: Four confirmed Northeast FOCUS missionaries exist here and are unnamed in search snippets. Worth a page-fetch pass if a future wave has fetching enabled; not recoverable by search snippet.

needs_review.issue: First-name-only teammates — George Washington University team
needs_review.finding: Gabriel Blank's focus.org page names his teammates as 'Catherine, Leo, and Tessa' — first names only. Not emitted, per the brief's explicit rule and the standing no-first-name-plus-initial rule.
needs_review.recommendation: Three GWU missionaries remain unrecoverable. Do not pair these first names with surnames from any other source.

needs_review.issue: Unnamed FOCUS cohort — Seton Hall University
needs_review.finding: Seton Hall Campus Ministry states that FOCUS and SPO missionaries live and serve on campus, roughly a dozen young adult missionaries, and that they are 'not directly employed by Seton Hall' but are part of the Discipleship Team. Two searches (shu.edu campus ministry Our Team, and the NJ regional query) returned no individual missionary names.
needs_review.recommendation: Likely the single largest unharvested Northeast FOCUS concentration found this wave. The named staff on the SHU page are priests (Rev. Nicholas C. Sertich, Rev. Nicholas G. Figurelli), who are chaplains and not FOCUS missionaries. Needs a page fetch, and the FOCUS/SPO split must be resolved before any name is emitted.

needs_review.issue: Wrong-org risk — Northeastern University Catholic Center
needs_review.finding: Two named missionaries surfaced at the Northeastern Catholic Center, but the snippet attributes involvement to Saint Paul's Outreach (SPO), not FOCUS. Both were withheld rather than emitted as FOCUS.
needs_review.recommendation: Northeastern appears to be an SPO campus, not a FOCUS campus. A future east-coast wave should treat SPO-staffed Boston centers (Northeastern, and possibly others in the Archdiocese of Boston) as out of scope for FOCUS unless a focus.org email or explicit FOCUS label is visible.

needs_review.issue: Chaplains and lay campus ministers listed alongside missionaries
needs_review.finding: Several rosters mix FOCUS missionaries with non-FOCUS staff. Withheld as non-FOCUS: Alison Hegarty, Caleb Gaeng, Paige Rienzo, Caitlyn Buttaci, Fr. Joe Cwik (Catholic Terps); Ben DiBello (UMaine, diocesan campus minister on a portlanddiocese.org address); Patrick Travers, Jule Coppa, Michael Gokie (Penn Newman); Fr. Gabriel Gillen O.P. (Providence College — a former FOCUS national chaplain, not a missionary); Jamie Boulding (Princeton Aquinas Institute); Fr. Mike Tabenero (Rutgers); Fr. Justin Bolger O.P. and Christina Germak (Brown-RISD); Sr. Bernadette Agustin (Quinnipiac).
needs_review.recommendation: Correctly excluded. Recorded so a later wave does not re-harvest them as FOCUS. Note that the reliable discriminator across every one of these pages is a focus.org email address.

needs_review.issue: Undated citation — Mike Wollen, Temple University
needs_review.finding: Emitted at medium confidence on a Facebook video title. No roster page for Temple's FOCUS team was retrievable, and the post carries no visible year.

needs_review.recommendation: Re-test as 'Michael Wollen' against site:focus.org/missionaries in a later wave; the legal-first-name variant was not testable within this wave's budget.

needs_review.finding: GMU Catholic Campus Ministry (gmuccm.org/focus-2) surfaced as a live FOCUS roster page but sits in Virginia, which the brief assigns to the focus-newman-south slice even though 'Arlington' appears in this slice's diocesan list.
